name: A Nymphomaniac's Phone
source:
In this visual novel you'll get into the skin of a young girl who used to be a sex addict. You'll take control of her everyday life and decide either to lead a faithful life and have a lot of fun with your boyfriend and maybe even corrupt him... Or to fall into temptation and live a lot of adventures.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/Souvenirs/about]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
在这部视觉小说中，你将扮演一个曾经是性瘾者的年轻女孩。你将掌控她的日常生活，并决定要么过上忠诚的生活，与你的男朋友一起享受很多乐趣，甚至可能腐蚀他……要么陷入诱惑，经历很多冒险。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/Souvenirs/about]Patreon[/url]]
